# G03 runtime worker handoff — 2026-10-30

Status: implementation frozen for root's final verification. No commits and no external model requests. Shared worktree HEAD began at d2e33ac341f19bbefd112c27a1d254075c6f4287. Earlier runtime plan hold status is superseded by this authorized implementation.

## Implemented

- Private process-local preparation, entered dispatch, undispatched proof and display linkage capabilities. Dispatch consumes exactly once, validates admitted capture digests, clears ambient authority before raw provider code, and prevents complete-to-stream double reserve.
- Independent physical observation through admitted stream/complete result regardless of consumer cancellation. Hosted lease owns normalization/settlement. Source durability and one Store projection precede normal terminal delivery; logical abort remains prompt. Retry drain retains original observation and does not redispatch.
- Shared ModelSession and complete helper perform native prepare/enter. Capture/snapshot/preparation failures close unprepared child reservations; prepared rejection uses final proof-backed zero. Exact captures expose credential-free normalized digest bindings.
- Standalone source initialization/replay and drain-before-Store-close; hosted source is not closed by runtime. ModelRegistry run lease authorities and operation ownership.
- Main stream, context overflow/thinking recovery, goal/memory/title, independent advisor and child normal/typed/outcome/compaction callers adopted. Main auxiliary capture/response repetition extracted into agent-auxiliary-model-invocation. Advisor physical linkage is inside the canonical review hash; explicit no-dispatch diagnostics have exact zero usage. Resource worker owns replay identity rehash.
- RunBudgetTracker adopts canonical accounting snapshots; primary logical turn/forecast counters remain independent. Auxiliary/Task display amounts never add to physical totals again. Known estimated budget debit remains available with incomplete totals. Child guard/compactor and continuation assessment use current canonical and immutable predecessor weighted/priced totals without rewriting continuation seals.

## Proven baseline fixture drift and correction

The legacy exact-all-subagent-events assertion at agent-runtime.test.ts2251 failed both current and archived d2e33ac3 source, identically, because accepted native child lifecycle adds checkpoint/reserved/model evidence. Baseline was git-archived packages/runtime+contracts with shared installed dependencies; location /tmp/napier-g03-runtime-baseline-location.txt, log /tmp/napier-g03-runtime-baseline-regression.log.

Root explicitly authorized a meaningful compatibility correction. The original parent outward lifecycle remains exact, while a new focused helper asserts exact native child checkpoints/reservation/response/terminal sequence, supervisor message counts and owner bindings, and cross-stream order. Original isolation/tool/context assertions remain. Current full45/45 passes; this is not an exclusion or weakened assertion.
